text:
maria.marketing: Quick alert 61; we're planning a short readout + benchmark highlights publish tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final press list, quoted lines, and a backup if an embargo is broken.

olivia.pr: Who's on-record? I need exact approved quote strings for the email.

maria.marketing: On-record: CEO and Head of Research. Off-record: product leads for technical deep dives. I'll paste the two approved quotes in a sec.

ben.engineering: FYI one chart still depends on an internal experiment flag. If it flips it changes the 95th pct. I'll remove dependency by EOD so numbers are stable.

tara.analytics: Running a final sanity on all cohorts now. ETA 25m. Will upload canonical CSV + checksums to the assets folder.

gina.legal: Quick reminder 61; avoid absolute phrasing in the headline (e.g., "fastest"), keep it "industry-grade" or similar. Legal ok with provided quotes pending exact wording.

maria.marketing: CEO quote (approved): "We make inference predictable at scale for engineering teams." Head of Research (approved): "This benchmark reflects production-like workloads and routing policies."

olivia.pr: Thanks. I'll draft the email and erratum template (in case numbers shift). Pressbot will wait for PR green to send.

pressbot: [automated] Standing by to schedule embargoed outreach to 20 contacts once PR triggers.

support.lead: Support prepping a short FAQ and will standby in #support-bench-live for the first two hours post-publish.

ben.engineering: Removing experiment flag now. I'll ping when stable.

tara.analytics: All cohorts validated. CSV + checksum uploaded: drive.redwood.ai/marketing/bench-assets/216789.

gina.legal: Reviewed PR copy. Minor edit: replace "production-like" with "production-oriented" in Head of Research quote.

maria.marketing: Done. Final check: assets in drive, PR email draft in the doc, legal sign-off confirmed. If no blockers, we'll lift at 10:00 PT tomorrow.

olivia.pr: No blockers from PR. I'll queue pressbot on publish.

pressbot: [automated] Will send embargoed emails at 10:00 PT tomorrow upon PR trigger.

maria.marketing: Thanks all. Post-publish debrief scheduled 4pm PT tomorrow. If embargo is broken pre-publish, we will: 1) publish early with a note, or 2) hold and update reporters depending on scale. Team thumbs-up?

olivia.pr: :+1:

tara.analytics: :+1: data side ready.

ben.engineering: :+1:

support.lead: :+1: support ready.

gina.legal: :+1:
